snippet.title: Vale's Echo - Release Date Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Vale wakes up dead on a train to nowhere, and her only company is Echo, a mischievous floating skull. This 2D cozy horror adventure mixes dark comedy with branching choices and odd puzzles, and you'll meet fish-human hybrids and leech merchants along the way.
